items.title: Fovlussea, a ranibizumab biosimilar (Accord Healthcare)
items.detail: CHMP adopted a positive opinion at its Oct 12–15 meeting. The European Commission decision is pending.

items.title: SZN-8141 DUET phase 1b/2a (Surrozen)
items.detail: FDA cleared the IND Oct 2; the second tranche of Surrozen's private placement, about $95.1 million, funds the DUET study in DME.

items.title: Tinlarebant for Stargardt disease type 1 (Belite Bio)
items.detail: PDUFA date for the NDA, which is under priority review.

items.title: 4D-150 4FRONT-1 phase 3 topline (4DMT)
items.detail: North American trial; randomization completed (N=523) in March 2026.

items.title: 4D-150 4FRONT-2 phase 3 topline (4DMT)
items.detail: Global trial; enrollment completed in June 2026, with more than 500 patients expected to be randomized.

items.title: Duravyu COMO and CAPRI phase 3 topline (EyePoint)
items.detail: Vorolanib insert in DME; the two trials enrolled 551 patients. EyePoint now prioritizes DME after ending its wet AMD trials early.

items.title: Duravyu LUCIA, wet AMD
items.detail: Missed BCVA noninferiority vs aflibercept 2 mg; effect sizes not disclosed.

items.title: Fovlussea (ranibizumab biosimilar), CHMP
items.detail: CHMP recommends approval; the European Commission decision is pending.
